# Diagnostic codes and their messages

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/list-diagnostics.mjs --write` from the packages' sources. Do not edit. -->

RF-19's audit ([release-foundation-plan.md](./commercialization/release-foundation-plan.md)): every code a package emits, with its message (`{…}` marks a value filled in at run time). A message should name what to do, or link to the page that does; **no** marks one that does neither, and *review* one whose message is computed at run time. 504 messages, 352 codes; 86 flagged, 53 to review.
